decisions.rationale: The bounded one-pass batch gives exact per-test stderr and PID cleanup evidence. Both controller failures are stale synthetic setup/create-once inputs; production correctly rejects them. Two local fixture corrections restore the intended coverage without weakening route, predecessor, immutability, or cleanup checks, so benefit clearly exceeds risk/cost.
decisions.smallest_fix: In the controller test file only, establish a real accepted route before signed close and generate a fresh sequence-bound proposal path per retained-session call; do not relax production.

decisions.rationale: The host fixture cannot reach its immutable-operation drift assertion because its synthetic bound authority predates required delegated scope/action/effect fields. Updating that test object to the exact current closed authority restores the existing negative assertion and is far safer than weakening canonical_bound_operation.
decisions.smallest_fix: Update only the host test helper's synthetic bound operation with valid delegated_user_scope_sha256, action_class, and scope_effect fields, preserving the later method-drift mutation.
